title: How many chickens are slaughtered for meat each year?
subtitle: Two hosts guess how many chickens are killed for meat each year, then shrink the answer to a size you can feel: per person and per second.
shape: 9 (with 6: a quizzes b and the viewer together; b overshoots)
notes: OWID/FAO 2024: 78.5 bn chickens (shown as 78), 6.6 bn in 1961 (×12), chickens ≈ 91% of land animals in the chart; ducks 4.2 bn are most of the rest, pigs + cattle 1.8 bn ≈ 1 in 50. Fix round: log slider 1–1000 bn (no anchor from b before the guess; b reveals an overshoot of 100 bn after); twists drawn: person + 10 chickens, stopwatch + 2,500/second, 1 chicken (1961) vs 12, a row of 9 chickens + '?' that becomes a duck. The engine does not keep the viewer's 'You' marker after an estimate's reveal; the counter stays up through b's reaction instead.
